```{r Call data, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#Because we updated the table in our data base, we need to establish a new connection with the updated table. We'll give it the same name and re-write the old connection.  
acs_01_24 <- tbl(con, "data_acs")
```

```{r Raw count of occupation, message = FALSE, warning= FALSE}
occ_raw <- acs_01_24 %>%
  filter(HISPAN == 2 | HISPAND == 200 | ANCESTR1 == 261,
         AGE >= 16,
         EMPSTAT == 1) %>%
  group_by(YEAR, occ2010) %>%
  summarise(workers = sum(PERWT, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  collect() %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  mutate(pc_wrk = workers / sum(workers) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r occ_cat1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
occ_cat1 <- acs_01_24 %>%
  filter(
    HISPAN == 2 | HISPAND == 200 | ANCESTR1 == 261,
    AGE >= 16,
    EMPSTAT == 1
  ) %>%
  group_by(YEAR, occ_cat1) %>%
  summarise(
    workers = sum(PERWT, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  collect() %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_workers = workers / sum(workers) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r plot worker, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(
  occ_cat1,
  aes(
    x = YEAR,
    y = workers,
    color = occ_cat1
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point() +
 # scale_color_manual(values = my_cols) +
  labs(
    title = "Puerto Rican Workers by Occupation",
    subtitle = "Etimated Puerto Rican workers by occupation",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Workers",
    color = "Occupation"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(2006,2008,2015,2017,2020),linetype = "dotted",
             color = "red") +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r plot pct_worker, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(
  occ_cat1,
  aes(
    x = YEAR,
    y = pct_workers,
    color = occ_cat1
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Occupational Distribution of Puerto Rican Workers",
    subtitle = "Share of employed Puerto Rican workers by occupation",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percent of Workers",
    color = "Occupation"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(2006,2008,2015,2017,2020),linetype = "dotted",
             color = "red") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r change workers, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
occ_change <- occ_cat1 %>%
  group_by(occ_cat1) %>%
  arrange(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    first_year = first(YEAR),
    last_year = last(YEAR),
    first_share = first(pct_workers),
    last_share = last(pct_workers),
    pp_change = last_share - first_share,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pp_change))

occ_change
```


```{r plot change, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(
  occ_change,
  aes(
    x = reorder(occ_cat1, pp_change),
    y = pp_change,
    fill = pp_change > 0
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Occupational Composition",
    subtitle = "Percentage-point change between first and last year",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage Point Change"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(fill = "none")
```

```{r index, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
occ_index <- occ_cat1%>%
  filter(occ_cat1 != "11. Military") %>%
  group_by(occ_cat1) %>%
  arrange(YEAR) %>%
  mutate(
    index = workers / first(workers) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r plot index, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

  )
) +

    y = "Index"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
# 2. Local-Side Analysis: Calculate Percentages
occupational_trends_data <- acs_01_24 %>%
  filter(HISPAN == 2 | HISPAND == 200 | ANCESTR1 == 261,
         AGE >= 16,
         EMPSTAT == 1) %>%
  group_by(YEAR, occ_cat1) %>%
  summarise(workers = sum(PERWT, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  collect()

occupational_trends <- occupational_trends_data %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  mutate(
    total_workers_in_year = sum(workers),
    pct_of_workforce = round((workers / total_workers_in_year) * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() 

# 3. View the Results
print(occupational_trends)

```


```{r}
ggplot(occupational_trends, aes(x = YEAR, y = pct_of_workforce, color = occ_cat1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Labor Force Participation Rate for Puerto Ricans by Age Group",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Participation Rate (%)",
    color = "Occupation"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
ind_occ_workers <- acs_01_24 %>%
  filter(
    HISPAN == 2 | HISPAND == 200 | ANCESTR1 == 261,
    AGE >= 16,
    EMPSTAT == 1
  ) %>%
  group_by(YEAR, occ_cat1,IND, occ2010) %>%
  summarise(workers = sum(PERWT, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  collect()
```

```{r}
# Top IND by workers within each occ_cat1
top_ind <- ind_occ_workers |>
  group_by(occ_cat1, IND) |>
  summarise(workers = sum(workers, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  slice_max(workers, n = 5, by = occ_cat1) |>
  arrange(occ_cat1, desc(workers))

# Top occ2010 by workers within each occ_cat1
top_occ <- ind_occ_workers |>
  group_by(occ_cat1, occ2010) |>
  summarise(workers = sum(workers, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  slice_max(workers, n = 5, by = occ_cat1) |>
  arrange(occ_cat1, desc(workers))

#top_ind
```
